creatures.fairy-town.ftIris2.description:
{green|Aurora}



{gold|Special Ability : Flying. Always positive Morale and Luck. Spellcaster.}

Can cast once per battle Sacred Cure spell. It's a weaker version of Archangel's Resurrection.

Aurora's positive morale ability can be affected only with Cursed Ground magical terrain or Spirit of Oppression artifact, since both interact with morale roll itself, rather than with morale level of the creature. Their morale cannot be decreased below +1 by the Sorrow spell, Holy Ground magical terrain effect, the morale forfeit for units from different towns or undead in the army, Bone and Ghost Dragon ability and any morale decreasing map objects effects.

The positive luck ability of auroras can be affected by Hourglass of the Evil Hour or Cursed Ground magical terrain only. Their luck cannot be decreased below +1 by any other luck modifier. Irises are unable to get luck unless being commanded by a hero, like all the other neutral creatures, despite the game saying that they have +1 luck.

Flying is a special ability of creatures, which allows them to bypass obstacles (e.g. walls) during combat. Having creatures with this special ability in a hero's army does not affect the movement of that hero on the adventure map in any way (meaning that flying creatures also cause a movement penalty on non-native terrain). Flying creatures are always immune to Quicksand.

Auroras are vulnerable for advanced Slayer.
creatures.fairy-town.ftNobleSprite1.name: Noble Sprites
Noble Sprite
creatures.fairy-town.ftNobleSprite2.desc:
{green|Sprite Queen}



{gold|Special Ability : Can cast Counterstrike. Can cast Pacifism and Magic Garland spells after attack. Aura of magic resistance.}

Sprite Queens have opportunity to cast advanced Counterstrike spell on friendly units for two turns. Additionally they have 100% chance to cast Magic Garland spell and 20% chance to cast Pacifism spell after they attack.

Pacifism is a mind spell that takes away from enemy units some battle skills (no retaliations, no additional attacks, no shoots, unit is willing to attack nearest creature). As any other minds spells - undead, non-living units and siege machines are immune to Pacifism. This spell can be countered by Hipnotize and Berserk.

Magic Garland is kind of magic touch (lasts 4 rounds). Creatures touched by Magic Garland are vulnerable for Sybil's Rose Bolt spell. Only siege machines can resist garland.

Counterstrike enables allied troops to retaliate extra times. The additional counterstrikes remain available until the end of the round, even if the spell is dispelled.

Sprite queens project a magic resistant aura which gives adjacent units a 20% chance to ignore the effects of hostile spells. This aura of resistance also applies to the creature itself.
creatures.fairy-town.ftNobleSprite2.name: Sprite Queens
Sprite Queen
creatures.fairy-town.ftSibyl2.bonus.cast:
{Enchanter}
Can cast Expert Bless, Shield and Stone Skin once for every 3 turns.
creatures.fairy-town.ftSibyl2.descriptio:
{green|Enchantress}



{gold|Special Ability : Ranged attack, No range penalty, No obstacle penalty. Spellcaster. Attacks with Rose Bolt.}

Enchantresses automatically cast following spells (but only 5 times per battle): Bless, Stone Skin, Shield. The spells are cast at the expert level every three rounds, lasting for three rounds. Despite the fact most of their spells are lvl 1, Enchantresses cannot cast on Cursed Ground magical terrain.

Sibyls ranged attack is called Rose Bolt. Units that are affected with Fearies, Noble Sprites and Sprite Queens' Magic Garland spell suffer more damage from sibils' magical bolts (additional damage is increased with hero spellpower).

Ranged attack is a special ability of creatures, which allows them to attack without engaging into hand-to-hand combat. Visually, typical ranged creature are armed with bows or crossbows (e.g. Elves or Archers), but there are also several creatures that use some kind of magic or elements (lightning, etc.), like Monks or Titans. However, this is only a visual effect and has no effect on the gameplay. When attacking in melee, most ranged creatures suffer melee penalty, which halves their damage. Some creatures have only melee attacks in basic variant but have ranged attack in upgraded version. Ranged penalty halves the ranged damage farther away than 10 hexes.

Obstacle penalty is a term for reduction of damage for ranged attacks. It occurs only during sieges when the target is behind walls. The attack suffering from the obstacle penalty only does half the damage compared to an attack made against a target being in front of the wall. The obstacle penalty is cumulative with the range penalty.

Range penalty is a reduction of damage for ranged attacks. It occurs when the target is further than 10 hexes from the shooter. An attack suffering from range penalty only does half the damage compared to attack made within the 10 hex radius. Range penalty is cumulative with the obstacle penalty.

Veterans whisper that sprites serving under her golden banner fly swifter and strike truer, as if her mere presence lent strength to their gossamer wings.

hero.fairy-town.ftO_Elrisa.name: Elrisa
hero.fairy-town.ftP_Arina.biography: Arina is said to be so kind and friendly that their isn't a general in the land who doesn't owe her a favor for a past kindness. As such many would allow her safe passage far easier than others in battle.
hero.fairy-town.ftP_Arina.name: Arina
